intro.title:
We envision a world
where energy systems
are sustainable and equitable for all.
paragraphs: To succeed with this, energy planning tools must be transparent, innovative, and locally adapted – and collaboration is key to make this happen.
Therefore it is our mission to mainstream open-source tools that enable this vision and empower all decision-makers and communities to plan, model and implement energy transition effectively.

services.title:
Make open-source energy planning
work for your organization

items.title: System Operators & Utilities
paragraphs: Use open-source tools for complexdemanding planning workflows while meeting institutional requirements for security, reliability, performance and integration.
We support model and data development, software deployment, validation, benchmarking, training, maintenance and ongoing technical support.
items.alt: Line workers servicing equipment on a transmission tower

items.title: Regulators & Public Authorities
paragraphs: Build independent and transparent analytical capabilities for energy policy, regulation and infrastructure assessment. We help public institutions select and adopt appropriate tools, establish reliable data and modelling workflows, train internal teams and assess plans using reproducible methods.

items.title: Consultancies & Engineering Firms
paragraphs: Add specialist open-source modelling, software and data capabilities to your client offer. We work as a technical partner on bids and projects, provide advanced modelling and software development, and help consulting teams build their own capacity to support open-source tools.

items.title: Foundations & Development Partners
paragraphs: Strengthen the shared tools, data and institutional capacity needed for transparent energy planning to spread. We design and deliver programmes that improve open-source infrastructure, close data and software gaps, support adoption by influential institutions and develop local delivery ecosystems.

items.title: Think Tanks, NGOs & Research Organizations
paragraphs: Develop credible open models, datasets and analytical workflows that can be scrutinised, reused and maintained.
We support tool development, applied modelling, data infrastructure, quality assurance, training and strategies for publishing and sustaining open-source work.

items.title: Technology Developers & investors
paragraphs: Apply transparent energy system modelling to investment or design questions. We develop transparent methods, datasets and tools to assess system value, infrastructure requirements and performance under future scenarios, working alongside commercial advisors where broader project or investment analysis is required.

items.title: Build
paragraphs: We build and maintain open-source data and software solutions for energy planning
Energy transition and planning studies with actionable insights for low-carbon strategy, investment, and resource adequacy, tailored to your needs.
items.note: Powered by transparent, reproducible open-source models, which we always make available to the client to adapt and re-use down the line.
items.alt: Wind turbines silhouetted against an orange sunset

items.title: Deploy
paragraphs: Enterprise-grade open-source platforms with flexible, secure and scalable software tools that meet your energy planning needs.
We deploy open tools to create trusted studies and insights, help institutions to develop the same capability and infrastructure and become more independent of proprietary modeling tool
items.note: Built on the latest international academic and industry knowledge, integrated into your data pipelines, and fully adapted to your requirements

items.title: Scale
paragraphs: Hands-on training programs, comprehensive guidance, and real-time technical support. We help best practises to spread through training and support, awareness building, benchmarks
items.note: For organizations and individuals who use open-source tools for impactful, smarter, and more sustainable energy planning.
items.alt: Colleagues talking during a training session

tools.title:
OET Supports
a Broad Range
of Modeling Platforms
paragraphs: We support a broad range of modeling platforms to meet diverse needs and also build secure, open-source applications that integrate proprietary data, ensuring accessibility, privacy, and local self-maintenance without requiring public sharing.
These include Python for Power System Analysis (PyPSA), the PyPSA-based European and global sector-coupled energy systems models PyPSA-Eur and PyPSA-Earth
